title: MIME boundary only checked against content bytes, not against all MIME parts
description: random_boundary() in sign.rs checks that the chosen boundary does not appear in content (the signed body part). RFC 2046 §5.1.1 says the boundary MUST NOT appear in any encapsulated body part. The second MIME part — the base64-encoded p7s signature — is not checked. While base64 output of a random boundary is extremely unlikely to match the boundary itself, the invariant is documented as RFC 2046 compliance but does not fully implement it.
close_reason: False positive. The boundary format '----=_Part_<hex>' contains hyphens and underscores which are not in the base64 alphabet [A-Za-z0-9+/=]. The signature block is base64-encoded, so the boundary string can never appear in it by construction. Only checking content_mime is correct and sufficient.
